label: BuilDrone
description: Quadrotor that deposits material in flight (foam variant: dual-canister spray; cementitious variant: extruder + delta arm).

label: ScanDrone
description: Quadrotor with onboard RGB-D camera; scans after every layer to assess print quality.

label: Human supervisor
description: Supervises autonomy; print verification, strategy input, operations management, H&S approvals, structural requirements, logistics.

label: Refill / battery crew
description: Manually refills material and swaps batteries (not automated in the paper).

label: Delta manipulator
description: Lightweight 3-limb parallel arm, pure translational end-effector; compensates drone drift and CoM-to-nozzle lever-arm offset.

label: Cementitious nozzle + tubing
description: Nozzle on delta end-effector, fed via tubing from extruder.

label: Cementitious cartridge
description: Servo + worm-drive extruder. Theoretical 310 mL, practical 202 mL (tapered insert + plunger).

label: Dual-component foam canisters
description: Two-part expanding foam canisters under the quadrotor; spray nozzle at holder bottom.

label: RGB-D camera (ScanDrone)
description: Captures depth+images for dense mapping of the top layer.

label: Motion tracking system
description: External motion-capture pose feed; indoor-only dependency.

label: FARO laser scanner
description: Ground-truth scan for post-hoc validation.

label: LED arrays
description: Used for virtual light-trail prints; color signals printing/non-printing state.

label: Onboard battery
description: Untethered power; manual swap; bounds sortie time.

label: ROS control architecture
description: ROS-based high-level architecture for all Aerial-AM platforms.

label: Model Predictive Control
description: Real-time MPC trajectory tracking on BuilDrone and ScanDrone.

label: Delta compensation controller
description: Kinematics-based controller that self-aligns nozzle against body error.

label: Dense mapping (supereight)
description: Fuses RGB-D frames + poses into a mesh of the built structure.

label: Contour slicer / job generator
description: Segments geometry into horizontal contour layers -> print jobs (176 jobs in dome virtual print).

label: Adaptive task allocation
description: Robots adaptively select jobs; population adapts to geometry.

label: Local path planner / collision awareness
description: Collision awareness vs other robots and the growing structure.

label: Toolpath generator
description: Concentric circles, rounded Peano curve, or hybrid paths.

label: Single blueprint / design input
description: Target geometry and structural requirements from human.

label: Slice into contour layers
description: Geometry -> layers -> jobs.

label: Allocate jobs to robots
description: Strategic loop assigns jobs, sizes the active fleet.

label: Load material + battery
description: Manual refill per layer/trip; battery swap.

label: Take off / approach
description: Fly to start of contour at reference height above structure.

label: Deposit layer in flight
description: Extrude/spray while tracking path with MPC (+delta).

label: Return / land
description: Return to base for refill.

label: Scan top layer
description: ScanDrone flies scan trajectory, builds mesh.

label: Evaluate layer
description: Compute mean top-layer height / deviations.

label: Adapt next trajectory
description: Offset next-layer path to nominal relative height; adjust plan.

label: Human verification
description: Supervisor checks and approves continuation.

label: Final validation
description: Compare as-built to FARO scan / design.

label: Payload limit
description: Each BuilDrone must extrude within power and payload limits; dictates material per trip.

label: One layer per load
description: Required a material refill after each layer (72 trips foam, 28 layers cement).

label: Manual refill & battery swap
description: Replenishment not automated; untethered claim only partly demonstrated.

label: Indoor motion-capture dependency
description: All experiments in indoor lab with external motion tracking; no outdoor validation.

label: Battery endurance
description: Sortie length bounded by battery; heavier payload = shorter flight.

label: Low deposition speed (cement)
description: Real print speed 1 cm/s (5 cm/s virtual).

label: Sequential printing for continuity
description: Two BuilDrones printed in sequence to keep construction continuous.

label: Human-in-the-loop required
description: Autonomous printing only under human supervision; H&S approvals.

label: Contour spatial constraint
description: As contours shrink with height, fewer robots fit; robots self-retire.

label: Tether trade-off
description: Tethering gives power/material but limits parallelism, trajectories, envelope, and shifts CoG.

label: Propeller downwash
description: Downwash deforms fresh material; needs rapid-curing / downwash-resistant mixes.

label: Irregular foam expansion
description: Layer height varies despite accurate flight -> scan correction required.

label: Wind / gusts outdoors
description: Not tested; outdoor flight will add disturbance to path tracking and spray.

label: Temperature / water temperature
description: Environmental conditions and water temperature affect curing and open time.

label: UV & weathering
description: Weather and UV reduce longevity of printed structures.

label: No mocap outdoors / GNSS degradation
description: Outdoor plan relies on multi-sensor SLAM + differential GPS; near tall structures GNSS degrades.

label: Lighting / sun on RGB-D
description: Not discussed in paper; sunlight degrades active depth sensing outdoors.

label: Communication loss
description: Handled via robot redundancy.

label: Mechanical failure
description: Handled via redundancy; no detailed FMEA.

label: Hard-to-access / at-height sites
description: Target use-case: disaster relief, tall buildings, remote sites — unprepared ground, obstacles.

label: Positional accuracy ≤ 5 mm
description: Delta arm brings max error to ~5 mm (reported acceptable within UK building requirements).

label: Layer resolution
description: Cement: 6 mm layer resolution; foam layer cross-section set by expanded bead size.

label: Thin single-wall contours
description: Demonstrated geometries are single-wall cylinders / surfaces of revolution.

label: Horizontal contour decomposition
description: Geometry must be sliceable into horizontal contour layers.

label: No support material
description: Support deposition unresolved -> overhangs limited.

label: Path length per load
description: Path must fit material per trip: Peano 2.975 m/layer; per 2 layers Peano 5.85 m, hybrid 6.79 m, concentric 7.61 m.

label: Structural design for Aerial-AM
description: Structural analysis and design-for-Aerial-AM still needed; materials not yet load-bearing like RC/steel.

label: Footprint vs fleet benefit
description: Larger diameters gain more from added robots; parabolic forms gain less (smaller avg contour).

label: Carryability
description: Must fit UAV power and payload.

label: Workability
description: Must flow through cartridge, tubing and nozzle.

label: Buildability
description: Must resist deformation under subsequent layers and downwash.

label: Open time
description: Must stay workable through loading+flight+deposition, then harden fast; must not set inside device.

label: Two-part PU expanding foam
description: Rapid-curing, ~30 kg/m³.

label: Cementitious-polymeric mixes No.1–4
description: PC + PFA + xanthan gum + HEMC + plasticiser (+foaming agent). Fresh density 1741–1793 kg/m³; yield stress 1.1 kPa (1–3), 0.7 kPa (4). No.1 best buildability, No.4 best workability. Target ~1700 kg/m³, 28-day ~25 MPa.

label: Flow-rate matching
description: Cartridge 0.294e-3 m/s, tubing 4.44e-3 m/s, bead 10e-3 m/s — extrusion must match flight speed.

label: Strength/durability & recyclability
description: Printable polymers/mixes lack RC/steel strength; thermosets hard to recycle.

label: Foam cylinder result
description: Ø0.3 m, 2.05 m, 72 layers, 24 s/layer, 29 min deposition; max error 15 mm H / 6 mm V; 2.27 cm median vs FARO.

label: Cement cylinder result
description: 28 layers, Ø0.335 m, 180 mm after settling, 2 h 13 min, ~5 mm max error, tip error median <4 mm.

label: Simulation result
description: More robots cut completion time; 15 m parabolic geometry with 15 robots simulated.

label: Top-layer height deviation
description: Mean top-layer height vs nominal; drives offset of next layer.

label: Nozzle position error
description: Nozzle tip vs reference path.

label: Completion time
description: Mission time vs robot count and geometry.

label: Material remaining
description: Remaining cartridge volume (production-needed signal).

label: Battery state of charge
description: Production-needed signal for scheduling swaps.

label: Cure / green strength state
description: Production-needed: whether layer below can bear next layer + downwash.

label: Automated refill & charging
description: Required to scale untethered operation.

label: Support material deposition
description: Unresolved.

label: Active curing
description: Unresolved.

label: Task-sharing between robots
description: Unresolved.

label: Outdoor multi-sensor SLAM + DGPS
description: Planned, not demonstrated.

label: Distributed-manufacturing efficiency metrics
description: Needed vs object scale and platform.

label: Codes & airspace regulation
description: Design/structural codes not adapted to AM; airspace/flight permits for multi-UAV ops.

label: Reinforcement / crack mitigation
description: Needed for load-bearing use.

label: Strategic manufacturing loop
description: Geometry -> jobs -> allocation -> fleet sizing; re-plans as print progresses.

label: Operational flight-control loop
description: MPC tracks path using mocap pose in real time.

label: Nozzle compensation loop
description: Delta arm cancels body drift so tip follows path (≤5 mm).

label: Scan-in-the-loop layer correction
description: Scan after every layer -> mean height -> offset next trajectory.

label: Human verification loop
description: Supervisor verifies print and approves / intervenes.

label: Material & energy logistics loop
description: Monitor material/battery -> schedule refill/swap -> reassign jobs (manual in paper; must be automated for production).

label: Cure-gating loop
description: Hold next layer until layer below reaches green strength (needed for cement at scale).

label: Environmental go/no-go loop
description: Wind, temp, humidity, light -> pause/resume, adjust speed/mix.

label: Fault-tolerance / reallocation loop
description: Comms loss or robot failure -> redundancy -> reassign jobs.
